## Theming: What's the point?

Build railway routes with string. The collection turns a physical route-building idea into several compact railway games.

### Before teaching

Treat this as an introduction, not a substitute for the rules in the box. The collection may contain different games with different objectives.

## Setting up: How to get started?

A verified official rulebook was unavailable when this page was prepared, so use the rulebook included with the edition being played for setup.

### Table check

Identify the specific game in the collection first. Keep its cards, boards, string, and any scoring material separate from the other games.

## Rounds and Phases

A verified official rulebook was unavailable. Do not rely on this page for turn order or route-placement rules.

### Safe teaching prompt

Ask one player to read the game's objective and a sample turn from the physical rulebook before the first placement.

## Scoring

A verified official rulebook was unavailable. Check the edition's rulebook for its end condition and scoring.

### Do not infer across games

A route rule or point value in one collection game need not apply to another.

## Terminology

**Route**: a railway connection represented with string. Exact game-specific terms vary across the collection.

### Edition-specific language

Use the terms printed in the rulebook for the game actually on the table.

## Official rules

No verified publisher-hosted rulebook, PDF, or rulings source was located. This page is intentionally only an introduction.

### Limitation

Without a verified source, this page deliberately gives no player count, setup count, action sequence, exception, or scoring procedure.
